pages.title: Bracelet weaving kits
pages.description: Create unique, handmade bracelets with our weaving kit. Perfect for beginners, it includes a frame loom, colorful yarns, and step-by-step instructions. Designed and made in Ireland from premium birch and featuring 100% Irish grown and spun yarn. With this beautiful sustainable kit you can craft unique, personalized woven jewelry with ease. UP to 50 designs included. For ages 8+
